translations.en.sahih: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dengan menyebut nama Allah Yang Maha Pemurah lagi Maha Penyayang.

translations.en.sahih: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
translations.en.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
translations.en.yusufali: Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds;
translations.id.indonesian: Segala puji bagi Allah, Tuhan semesta alam.

translations.en.sahih: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
translations.en.pickthall: Master of the Day of Judgment,
translations.en.yusufali: Master of the Day of Judgment.

translations.en.sahih: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
translations.en.pickthall: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
translations.en.yusufali: Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek.
translations.id.indonesian: Hanya Engkaulah yang kami sembah, dan hanya kepada Engkaulah kami meminta pertolongan.

translations.en.sahih: Guide us to the straight path -

arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
translations.en.pickthall: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.
translations.en.yusufali: The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) Jalan orang-orang yang telah Engkau beri nikmat kepada mereka; bukan (jalan) mereka yang dimurkai dan bukan (pula jalan) mereka yang sesat.
